name: Shunpuu Shoujo
source:
Sesa Takuma is a college student. One day a girl named Sairi from a different world appears before him. She said that she appeared to purify the conscious body possessed by Takuma and they should live together during that process. Takuma's friends and female classmates aren't really happy about that. Where shall the future take him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
濑佐拓真是一名大学生。一天，来自异世界的女孩赛莉出现在他面前。她说自己是为了净化附身于拓真身上的意识体而来，在此期间两人必须共同生活。拓真的朋友和女同学对此并不高兴。他的未来将走向何方？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
